en-US.title: Five Baby Birds | Animal Nursery Rhymes | Cocomelon Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs | Cocomelon Popul...
en-US.description:
🍉 Five little birds take their first flight! Watch as the mother bird helps them learn to fly!

Subscribe and watch new videos uploaded every week!: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNvn7bFpHvfvULxpRf2Ea-g?sub_confirmation=1

Five little bird eggs were in the nest,

placed at the top of the tree.

Cracks began to form in the eggs,

and all the baby birds hatched.

The first baby bird looked down at the ground. Startled, it took a step back.
The mother bird said, "Fly, soar, soar."
But the baby bird said, "I'm scared, chirp, chirp."
As the first baby bird left the nest,
the second baby bird looked back.
The mother bird said, "Fly, soar, soar."
But the baby bird said, "What should I do, chirp, chirp."
As the second baby bird flew high,
the third baby bird sighed.
The mother bird said, "Fly, soar, soar."
But the baby bird said, "It's too high, chirp, chirp."
As the third baby bird flew away,
the fourth baby bird pouted.

The mother bird said, "Fly, soar, soar."
But the baby bird said, "I don't want to, chirp, chirp."
As the fourth baby bird went to look for food,
the youngest baby bird cried loudly. The mother bird said, "Fly, soar, soar."

But the baby bird said, "I'm scared, chirp, chirp."

The mother bird said, "It's okay."

"You can fly, too."

The baby bird sang a lala song,

and flapped its wings and flew.

Five baby birds followed their mother,

soaring through the sky.

The mother bird said, "Keep flying high."

“아기 돼지, 아기 돼지, 문을 열어봐.”
“무슨 일이 있어도 절대 못 열어!”
“그럼 불어서 날려야지, 훅 훅 훅!”
“그럼 불어서 날려야지, 훅 훅 훅!”
벽돌집은, 꿈쩍 안 했어!
어쩔 줄 모르던 늑대는
지붕에 올라가 굴뚝으로 갔어.
이빨을 드러낸 늑댈 보고

막내가 나무에 불을 붙였어.
연기가 높이 높이 치솟았지.
꼬리에 불이 붙어...
